newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World Jan-July air cargo traffic up 5.4 pct - ACI.
newsitem.headline: World Jan-July air cargo traffic up 5.4 pct - ACI.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 488 airports around the world between January and July 1996, totalled 27.80 million tonnes, up 5.4 percent on the same period the previous year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 14.56 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 6.4 percent on January-July 1995.
Jan-July 1996 volume at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 5.76 million tonnes, a rise of 3.9 percent on the same period in 1995.

Cargo at airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), totalled 5.63 million tonnes, up 4.1 percent on the first seven months of last year, ACI said.
Middle East airports recorded the highest growth rate of ACI's cargo-handling regions in the period in question, throughput rising 17.1 percent to 956,539 tonnes.
But traffic at Latin America/Caribbrean airports in Jan-July 1996 fell 5.7 percent on 1995 levels to 624,653 tonnes.
African airports' cargo traffic rose 1.5 percent on the first seven months of 1995 to 263,253 tonnes. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
